details: VELDO-0089 detail: install/assets: .veldo/control_team.py installed by the scaffold; .veldo/control_team.py engine copy identical; .veldo/control_team.py laid by the installer

VELDO-0089 detail: team/schema-closed: the specification's role fields are exactly the schema's; no tool or capability field in the schema; a role with tools and MCP servers is refused by name; an undeclared role is refused by name

VELDO-0089 detail: team/incomplete-roster: a team without independent review is refused and asks the owner; the refusal is incomplete_roster naming the missing role; an empty review role is refused the same way

VELDO-0089 detail: team/conflicting-staffing: two project managers; a builder who also reviews; a reviewer in a builder's independence group; a worker nobody enrolled is never invented; a member outside the project is not staffed

VELDO-0089 detail: team/project-requirements: a role budget above the project's coordination budget; an engine that is no registered adapter; a role without its responsibility; independent review not declared separate from implementation; the engines are the registered subscription adapters

VELDO-0089 detail: team/complete-proposal: a complete team is recorded as the pending proposal; bound to exactly its content; and nothing is accepted yet; every earlier staffing problem is an open owner request; another process reads the same proposal

VELDO-0089 detail: team/owner-amendment: and amended the team to revision 1; the revision names the settlement and the owner; a second revision amends the first; the stored first revision is unchanged; another process reads the accepted revision
VELDO-0089 detail: team/stale-amendment: a command bound to an older team version is refused; an answer to a superseded proposal is refused; and the team stays at revision 2

VELDO-0089 detail: team/altered-amendment: a command altered after signing is refused; content changed after the owner's answer is refused; an answer to another brief is refused; and the team stays at revision 2

VELDO-0089 detail: team/self-promotion: the promotion is only a proposal; it does not apply without a settled answer; the manager's own answer settles nothing; another project owner's answer is not the owner's; a member outside the project proposes nothing; the manager is still no reviewer
VELDO-0089 detail: team/roster-not-authority: amendments were accepted; a proposal permission naming an authority is refused; a proposal permission naming a settlement touchpoint is refused

VELDO-0089 detail: team/policy-required: the service reads VELDO-0049's own policy record; no policy and no reviewer is refused; no policy and one reviewer is refused; a risk the policy has no count for is refused; and no assignment exists

VELDO-0089 detail: team/valid-assignment: an independent critical assignment succeeds; bound to the current team revision; bound to the policy and its count; bound to the exact subject; a standard unit needs one review; another process reads both
VELDO-0089 detail: team/review-count: a critical unit with one review is refused; a standard unit with none is refused
VELDO-0089 detail: team/independence: the builder reviewing his own unit is refused; one reviewer in two positions is refused; a reviewer who is no independent reviewer is refused
VELDO-0089 detail: team/exact-subject: a reviewer bound to another unit is refused; a reviewer bound to an older revision is refused; a builder bound to another unit is refused
VELDO-0089 detail: team/stale-team: an assignment under an older team revision is refused; a worker who is not the manager assigns nothing; the project's owner may assign
VELDO-0089 detail: team/observability: every command is observed with its outcome; pending work is counted
